questions.question: Who appoints the State Election Commissioner?

• The State Election Commissioner is responsible for conducting and overseeing elections at the local level, such as municipal and panchayat elections.
 
• The term of office and conditions of service of the State Election Commissioner are also determined by the **Governor**.

questions.question: In India, Micro Finance Institutions primarily target which segment of the population?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Low-income individuals and small businesses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Micro Finance Institutions (MFIs)** are financial entities that provide small loans to people who do not have access to traditional banking services.
 
• In India, MFIs primarily target **low-income individuals** and **small businesses** to help them improve their livelihoods.
 
• These institutions aim to promote **financial inclusion** by providing credit to those who are underserved by formal financial institutions.
 
• MFIs often provide **loans** for purposes such as starting or expanding a small business, education, healthcare, and housing.
 
• By targeting low-income segments, MFIs help in **poverty alleviation** and economic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Microfinance Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Microcredit**
 Small loans given to individuals or small businesses to meet their financial needs.
 
 

 **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**
 Groups of 10-20 people, usually women, who pool their savings and lend to members.
 
 

 **Joint Liability Groups (JLGs)**
 Groups of individuals who take loans collectively and are jointly liable for repayment.
 
 

 **Financial Inclusion**
 Ensuring access to financial services for all segments of society, particularly the underserved.
 
 

 **Micro Savings**
 Small savings accounts offered to low-income individuals to encourage saving habits.
 
 

 **Micro Insurance**
 Insurance products designed to be affordable for low-income individuals.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of money?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Perishability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

- **Money** is characterized by **Portability**, meaning it can be easily carried and used for transactions. - **Durability** ensures that money can withstand physical wear and tear. - **Divisibility** allows money to be broken down into smaller units for various transactions. - **Perishability** is not a characteristic of money; money does not spoil or decay over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Money** is a medium of exchange that facilitates trade and economic activities. It has several key characteristics that make it effective:

 
 

 Characteristic
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Portability
 **Money** can be easily carried and used for transactions.
 
 

 Durability
 **Money** is physically durable and can withstand wear and tear.
 
 

 Divisibility
 **Money** can be divided into smaller units to facilitate various transactions.
 
 

 Uniformity
 All units of **money** are identical in terms of value and appearance.
 
 

 Acceptability
 **Money** is widely accepted as a medium of exchange.
 
 

 Limited Supply
 The supply of **money** is regulated to maintain its value.

questions.question: Among the given options, which one causes an echo?

options.text: When sound waves travel through a solid medium
When sound waves travel through a liquid medium
When sound waves travel through a vacuum

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **When sound is reflected**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Echo** is a phenomenon where sound waves are reflected back to the listener, causing a repetition of the original sound.
 
• For an echo to be heard, the reflected sound must reach the listener at least 0.1 seconds after the original sound.
 
• The distance between the sound source and the reflecting surface must be significant for an echo to be perceived.
 
• Common environments where echoes are noticed include large empty halls, mountains, and canyons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sound Reflection**: The bouncing back of sound waves when they hit a surface that does not absorb the sound.
 
• **Absorption**: Some materials absorb sound waves, preventing echoes. Examples include carpets and curtains.
 
• **Reverberation**: Unlike an echo, reverberation is the persistence of sound in a particular space after the original sound is produced.
 
• **Acoustic Design**: Modern architecture often incorporates materials and designs to manage echoes and reverberation in buildings.

questions.question: On 8th April 1929, who among the following two revolutionists threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly?

options.text: Bhagat Singh and Ram Prasad Bismil

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagat Singh** and **Batukeshwar Dutt** threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly on 8th April 1929.
 
• Their intention was to protest against the repressive laws being enacted by the British government.
 
• They did not intend to kill anyone; the bomb was thrown in an empty space to make a loud noise and attract attention.
 
• After throwing the bomb, both revolutionaries stayed at the scene, shouting slogans and distributing pamphlets.
 
• They were arrested on the spot and later faced trial for their actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Revolutionary
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Bhagat Singh**
 A prominent Indian revolutionary who played a key role in the Indian independence movement. He was known for his bravery and martyrdom at a young age.
 
 

 **Batukeshwar Dutt**
 An Indian revolutionary and freedom fighter who was associated with the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA). He is best known for his collaboration with Bhagat Singh in the Central Legislative Assembly bombing.
 
 

 **Central Legislative Assembly**
 The legislative body of British India where the bomb was thrown by Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt to protest against colonial rule.
 
 

 **HSRA**
 The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association, a revolutionary organization in India whose aim was to overthrow British rule through armed struggle.
 
 

 **Martyrdom**
 The death or suffering of a martyr. Bhagat Singh, along with other revolutionaries, became a martyr for the cause of India's independence.
